description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommandStrategies' that manages command handling strategies within a command pattern framework. It delegates commands to specific strategies, handles unhandled commands, and maintains a map of command classes to strategies.

classes.name: AbstractCommandStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class that delegates command handling to specific strategies based on command class, providing mechanisms to add strategies, handle unhandled commands, and apply strategies.

methods.name: getEmptyResult
methods.description: Abstract method to return an empty result of type R.

methods.name: addStrategy
methods.description: Adds a command strategy to the internal strategies map; should be called only in constructor.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles commands that cannot be processed by this strategy, logs the event, and returns an empty result.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if a command class has a registered strategy.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, can be overridden to compute metadata relative to an entity and command.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Applies the appropriate command strategy if available; otherwise, handles as unhandled.

methods.name: getAppropriateStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the command strategy matching the command class from the strategies map.
